signal: Sonatus unveiled its AI Director platform at CES 2026 and surpassed 6 million production vehicles running its software

email.body1:
Sam, saw Sonatus unveiled AI Director at CES and crossed 6 million production vehicles on your software.

Momentum like that usually opens more OEM and tier-one accounts than the team can work before the launch buzz fades, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Sonatus off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Sam, quick follow-up for Sonatus.

A new platform plus CES momentum usually raises the pipeline target faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Sonatus needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Sam, last bit of proof for Sonatus.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Sonatus's reply rate likely compares to other automotive software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Sam, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most right after a CES launch, and I know that window gets busy fast.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an automotive software motion? I will tailor it to Sonatus either way.
